facts.heading: Divorce from husband
facts.content: Jana and her husband decided to get a divorce after 15 years of marriage. Jana still cannot understand the decision.
facts.evidence: After 15 years of marriage, my husband and I decided to get a divorce. And I still can't understand it.

facts.heading: Divorce approval delay
facts.content: The government had not yet approved the divorce in Croatia. In September, they told Jana it was not going any further.
facts.evidence: in September they told me that it was not going any further.

facts.heading: Feelings during divorce
facts.content: Jana experienced emptiness and anger several times a day during the divorce process.
facts.evidence: Emptiness. Then anger. Then emptiness again. It was several times a day.

facts.heading: Reflection on marriage
facts.content: Jana thinks she should have seen things and feels she was blind. She keeps looking for mistakes.
facts.evidence: That I should have seen it, that I was blind. I keep thinking about it and I keep looking for mistakes.

facts.heading: Reason for feeling tired
facts.content: Jana thinks she was too tired and not interested in the issues. She also thinks she got too old.
facts.evidence: I think I was too tired and I wasn't interested in them. Only that I got too old.

facts.heading: Difficulty telling children
facts.content: Jana has two children, Anšce and Matěj, who are both 8 years old. Jana does not know how to tell them about the divorce.
facts.evidence: I have two kids, Anšce and Matěj. They're 8 years old. I don't know how to tell them.

facts.heading: Daughter's suspicion
facts.content: Anšce has become more suspicious about the situation. She asked Jana if they were dating last week.
facts.evidence: Last week she asked me if we were dating.

facts.heading: Daughter's lie
facts.content: Anšce lied to Jana and knew it. Anšce lied about Jana destroying her life and taking her home.
facts.evidence: she lied to me. And she knew it. I saw it in her eyes. That I destroy her life. That I take her home.

facts.heading: Fear of telling truth
facts.content: Jana is afraid of her children's tears when telling them the truth. She prefers to keep the truth with her.
facts.evidence: I'm afraid of their tears. I'd rather have it with me, but I'm afraid of their tears.

facts.heading: Matěj's understanding
facts.content: Matěj is still small and does not understand much about the situation.
facts.evidence: Matěj is still small, he doesn't understand much.

facts.heading: Desire for stability
facts.content: Jana wants to feel like a real person, especially regarding living in a mortgage. She wants the residents to stay with her.
facts.evidence: Living in a mortgage, I'd rather feel like a real person, at least I feel. So they stay with me.

facts.heading: Work as a teacher
facts.content: Jana works as a Czech teacher at a primary school in Brno. She teaches 9th and 8th grade.
facts.evidence: I work as a Czech teacher at a primary school in Brno. I teach 9th and 8th grade.

facts.heading: Current study habit
facts.content: Jana studies by walking around with a rabbit in her hand.
facts.evidence: I walk around with a rabbit in my hand.

facts.heading: Feeling life is falling apart
facts.content: Jana has a feeling that her life is falling apart. She told the principal about crying on the court.
facts.evidence: I have a feeling that everyone sees that my life is falling apart. I told her that because I once cried on the court.

facts.heading: Principal provided time off
facts.content: The principal let Jana leave earlier and gave her an hour off. This helped Jana.
facts.evidence: That she let me leave earlier, gave me an hour off. Only then I sat at home and it was worse.

facts.heading: Work environment was isolating
facts.content: Jana was alone at work and had something to do. This made things worse.
facts.evidence: Because I was alone at work, I had at least something to do. Only then I sat at home and it was worse.

facts.heading: Sleep problems at night
facts.content: Jana sleeps badly and wakes up at 3 am to think about what is next.
facts.evidence: Every night I wake up at 3 am and I think about what's next.

facts.heading: Jana's current situation
facts.content: Jana states she does not have a mortgage, a wife, or anything.
facts.evidence: I don't have a mortgage, I don't have a wife, I have nothing.

facts.heading: Jana's sleep schedule
facts.content: Jana sleeps around 5 am and wakes up at 6:30 am. She feels tired in the morning.
facts.evidence: I sleep around 5 and wake up at 6.30. I'm tired already in the morning.

facts.heading: Weight loss reported
facts.content: Jana moved a little and lost 4 kilos. A friend told her she looks terrible.
facts.evidence: I move a little. I lost 4 kilos. My friend tells me I look terrible.

facts.heading: Sister Alen is supportive
facts.content: Jana has a sister named Alen in Olmouc who calls her almost every evening.
facts.evidence: I have sister Alen in Olmouc. She calls me almost every evening.

facts.heading: Fear of sister's judgment
facts.content: Jana is afraid her sister Alen will think she lied to her.
facts.evidence: That I lied to her. That a woman who can't keep a marriage is not a good example for children.

facts.heading: Mother's influence on marriage
facts.content: Jana's mother always said marriage is held and it is up to the individual.
facts.evidence: She always said that marriage is held and it's up to you.

facts.heading: Mother's reaction to Jana
facts.content: When Jana told her something, her mother was moaning and expressed hope that Jana had been good to her.
facts.evidence: She was moaning. Then she said that she hopes that I have been good to her.

facts.heading: Mother's contact decreased
facts.content: The mother has not called Jana much since the interaction.
facts.evidence: She hasn't called me much since then.

facts.heading: Jana feels sad
facts.content: Jana feels sad and wishes her mother would hug her.
facts.evidence: Sad. I would need her to hug me.

facts.heading: Jana's desire to express feelings
facts.content: Jana wants to tell her mother that it hurts and she does not want to be alone.
facts.evidence: That it hurts, that I don't want to be alone, but that it doesn't happen here.

facts.heading: Jana's hesitation to speak out
facts.content: Jana has not told anyone about these feelings yet. She finds it strange but helpful to say them out loud.
facts.evidence: I haven't told anyone about this yet. It's strange to sit here and say it all out loud, but it helps a little.

facts.heading: Seeking help for sleep
facts.content: Jana has tried herbivore tea for sleep. She does not want medication.
facts.evidence: Herbivore tea, that's all. The doctor didn't give me any pills, but I don't want to.

facts.heading: Fear of addiction regarding sleep
facts.content: Jana is afraid she will not wake up in time for the children and does not want to be addicted.
facts.evidence: I'm afraid I wouldn't wake up in time for the children and I don't want to be addicted.

facts.heading: Patient considered writing
facts.content: Jana considered writing something to help her. She thought this might get it out of her head.
facts.evidence: let the paper write what will wake you up. I could, but at least I'll get it out of my head.

facts.heading: Patient expressed fear of panic
facts.content: Jana expressed a fear of panicking and crying. She also worried about not staying calm.
facts.evidence: That I panic and cry, that I can't stay calm.

facts.heading: Patient questioned self-worth
facts.content: Jana questioned if she would be a coward. She also wondered if she was allowed.
facts.evidence: That I'd be a coward? Or you could see that I'm so allowed.

facts.heading: Patient expressed need for connection
facts.content: Jana expressed a need to feel not alone. She also expressed that she does not have to do things right away.
facts.evidence: That I'm not alone and that I don't have to do it right away.
